OPPO Find X10 Series Launches Globally with True-to-Life Imaging and All-Round Flagship Upgrades | OPPO Global

# OPPO Find X10 Series Launches Globally with True-to-Life Imaging and All-Round Flagship Upgrades

MALLORCA, October 21, 2026–Leading global smart device brand OPPO today announced the global launch of its latest flagship smartphones, Find X10 and Find X10 Pro Max. Built to be a "Hasselblad True-to-Life Camera," Find X10 Series brings major advances in camera hardware and computational photography to deliver a more true-to-life imaging experience. Beyond imaging, the series introduces refined designs, upgraded displays, larger batteries, flagship performance and the new ColorOS 17.

...

Industry-First Triple 200MP Camera System

Find X10 Series introduces a new-generation camera system co-developed with Hasselblad. Find X10 features a Dual 200MP Camera System, while Find X10 Pro Max pushes further with a Triple 200MP Camera System, bringing 200MP resolution across all three rear cameras.

...

Building on its breakthrough camera hardware, Find X10 Series debuts OPPO's next-generation computational photography solution, LUMO True Image Engine. By combining OPPO's latest imaging expertise with a more natural approach to image processing, LUMO True Image Engine is designed to preserve true-to-life color, tone and detail, helping photos stay faithful to the original scene.

...

Both Find X10 and Find X10 Pro Max feature up to an 8,000mAh OPPO Silicon-Carbon Battery 3, delivering a substantial upgrade in battery life. Whether capturing photos, recording video, gaming or simply getting through a busy day, the larger battery gives users greater confidence to keep going without constantly worrying about power.

...

Find X10 Series debuts ColorOS 17, delivering a new level of smoothness alongside more intelligent, system-level AI capabilities.

...

Privacy and security remain at the core of ColorOS 17. AI Call Guard uses on-device AI to detect emerging fraud risks such as synthetic voices and AI face swaps during calls 6. OPPO's Private Computing Cloud protects cloud-based AI processing with end-to-end encryption and new post-quantum security capabilities.

OPPO Find X10 and Find X10 Pro Max Availability

OPPO Find X10 and Find X10 Pro Max will be available globally beginning in late October. The devices will be offered through official OPPO stores, authorized retailers and partner carriers across global markets. For detailed information about pre-orders and launch promotions, visit https://www.oppo.com/en/ or follow OPPO's official social media channels.

Title: OPPO Launches Enco X4 with Dynaudio Co-Tuned Acoustic System, AI Adaptive ANC and Smarter Everyday Experiences | OPPO Global
URL: https://www.oppo.com/en/newsroom/press/oppo-launches-enco-x4-with-dynaudio-co-tuned-acoustic-system/
Published: 2026-10-21T00:00:00.000Z
Author: N/A
Highlights:
OPPO Launches Enco X4 with Dynaudio Co-Tuned Acoustic System, AI Adaptive ANC and Smarter Everyday Experiences | OPPO Global

# OPPO Launches Enco X4 with Dynaudio Co-Tuned Acoustic System, AI Adaptive ANC and Smarter Everyday Experiences

PALMA, October 21, 2026—OPPO today announced the launch of OPPO Enco X4, its latest flagship true wireless earbuds. Featuring the Dynaudio Co-Tuned Acoustic System, OPPO Enco X4 delivers true, natural sound with authentic musical fidelity. For commuting and travel, AI Adaptive ANC intelligently adjusts active noise cancellation and transparency levels based on both ambient noise and user preferences, making listening more comfortable. Smart connectivity and AI experiences also help with everyday listening, communication and travel.

...

Flagship Sound, Co-Tuned with Dynaudio

OPPO Enco X4 features a new-generation dual-driver acoustic system combining an 11mm TRF diaphragm woofer with a 6mm planar diaphragm tweeter, with each driver powered by a dedicated high-performance DAC to independently process different frequency ranges. Together, this dual-driver, dual-DAC architecture delivers more acoustic energy while also ensuring more faithful sound reproduction across the frequency range.

Building on seven consecutive years of collaboration with Dynaudio, OPPO Enco X4 offers five exclusive sound profiles tailored to different music genres and listening preferences, giving users greater freedom to find the sound that suits them best.

...

Enco X4 is also OPPO's first pair of TWS earbuds to support lossless audio, enabling full-chain wireless lossless audio transmission via LHDC Lossless when paired with OPPO Find X10 Series. And with transmission rates of up to 2.3Mbps, OPPO Enco X4 supports lossless playback at up to 24-bit/48kHz, helping overcome the bandwidth limitations of conventional Bluetooth audio and preserve more of the detail and layering in the original recording. OPPO Enco X4 is also Hi-Res Audio Wireless certified.

...

OPPO Enco X4 debuts a new-generation noise cancellation system featuring Low‑Strain Noise‑Cancelling Ear Tips, a triple-microphone system, a powerful 6nm NPU, and the latest intelligent ANC algorithms. The system delivers up to 100% stronger overall noise cancellation performance compared with the previous generation 1, helping reduce the constant background noise encountered across trains, buses, taxis and other daily journeys. Human voices are among the most challenging sounds to cancel in busy public spaces, but OPPO Enco X4 improves noise cancellation performance in the vocal frequency range by up to 30% compared with the last generation 1, helping reduce surrounding conversational noise and create a quieter, more focused listening experience throughout the commute.

...

With support for Bluetooth® 6.1, Smart Bluetooth 3 and Dual Connection Across Systems, OPPO Enco X4 offers faster, more stable connectivity and seamless

...

Building on this seamless connectivity, OPPO Enco X4 brings practical AI-powered features into everyday use. AI Live Translation 4 supports real-time translation and interpretation across more than 30 languages, helping users communicate effortlessly during international meetings and overseas travel.

OPPO Enco X4 is OPPO's first pair of earbuds to support voice activation with Google Gemini. Users can say "Hey Google," through the earbuds when connected to a compatible device, for convenient hands-free assistance on the go 5.

...

and seamless communication to capturing and creating content on the go.

Title: Bee Frontier and Bee Eclipse: Introducing new AI wearable and phone attachment
URL: https://www.aboutamazon.com/news/devices/amazon-personal-ai-bee-frontier-bee-eclipse
Published: 2026-10-15T11:55:24.000Z
Author: Amazon Staff
Highlights:
Bee Frontier and Bee Eclipse: Introducing new AI wearable and phone attachment

# Amazon introduces 2 new AI products from Bee: Bee Frontier and Bee Eclipse

Bee expands its ambient AI family with two personal AI devices designed to remember the moments that matter most, plus new integrations with Alexa+ and Amazon.com.

Written by Amazon Staff

## Key takeaways

- Bee is personal AI that remembers what matters from your conversations and turns it into useful insights and reminders.
- Bee Frontier is our next-generation AI wearable, and Bee Eclipse is a magnetic phone attachment.
- Connect Bee to Alexa+ to ask Alexa for hands-free summaries and to-dos, or to Amazon.com for personalized shopping.
- Bee is private—audio is processed in real time then deleted, and customers have control of their data.

...

Leaning on AI to help you remember important details—and stay more present in the moment—has gone from novelty to habit in just a couple of years. The first Bee device, Bee Pioneer, was one of the original personal AI products to offer more than audio transcription. Today, we’re taking the next step in Bee’s journey with two new devices that expand what personal AI can do: Bee Frontier, the next generation of our AI wearable, and Bee Eclipse, an all-new design that attaches magnetically to your phone.

...

## Bee Frontier: Personal AI you can wear on your wrist or clip onto clothing

Bee Frontier personal AI you can wear or clip on to clothes—available in Sage, Lavender, and Onyx colors.

Bee Frontier is personal AI you can wear on your wrist or clip on to clothes. It’s light, features an ultra-soft silicone wristband built for all-day comfort, and comes in three nature-inspired colors—Lavender, Sage, and Onyx.

With IP67 water resistance, up to seven days of battery life, and USB-C charging, Bee Frontier is designed to stay with you through a full week without interruption—allowing it to get smarter and more useful for you over time. It features dual microphones with advanced noise filtering, so it can take note of what matters and ignore what doesn’t, even in noisy environments like a crowded restaurant or open office.

...

## Bee Eclipse: Personal AI that attaches to your phone

Bee Eclipse attaches magnetically to the back of a phone.

Bee Eclipse is a new addition to the Bee lineup, giving customers more options beyond a wearable. It’s a slim, lightweight device about the size of a credit card that attaches to the back of your phone magnetically. Nothing extra to remember—just attach it and go. With more than 21 days of battery life on a single charge, it’s designed to keep up with you for weeks at a time.

Bee Eclipse works like Bee Frontier, helping you turn conversations into useful summaries, insights, and to-dos. As with all Bee devices, audio is never stored, cannot be accessed or shared, and users are prompted to gain permission from call participants each time a recording is started.

...

## New connections with Alexa+ and Amazon.com

In addition to a new generation of hardware, Bee is introducing the ability to connect to Alexa+ and Amazon.com, making it even easier to remember, find, and buy what you need. By connecting Bee to Alexa+, you can get hands-free access to your summaries, insights, and to-dos, so instead of pulling out your phone, you ask Alexa for a meeting summary, check your to-dos, or pull up the name of the book your friend suggested. Connecting Bee to Amazon.com enables even more personalized shopping recommendations—your Bee device can surface items you mention before you forget with product recommendations on the Amazon homepage, and in the Bee mobile and desktop apps.

...

## Bee Frontier and Bee Eclipse: Availability and pricing

Bee Frontier is available now for $74.99 in Onyx, Lavender, and Sage at Amazon.com. Bee Eclipse will be available soon, starting at $99.99 in Silver, Midnight, Honey, and Blush.

---

Title: Meet Apple HomeView, a new way to enjoy entertainment and manage the home - Apple
URL: https://www.apple.com/newsroom/2026/10/meet-apple-homeview-a-new-way-to-enjoy-entertainment-and-manage-the-home/
Published: 2026-10-13T00:00:00.000Z
Author: N/A
Highlights:
Meet Apple HomeView, a new way to enjoy entertainment and manage the home - Apple

 PRESS RELEASE October 13, 2026 

# Meet Apple HomeView, a new way to enjoy entertainment, stay connected, and manage the home 

 Apple HomeView is powered by Apple Intelligence with Siri AI and built with privacy and security at its core 

 Powered by Apple Intelligence with Siri AI, Apple HomeView brings entertainment, connection, and smart home management together in one place. 

CUPERTINO, CALIFORNIA Apple today introduced Apple HomeView, designed to be central to the home and personal to everyone in it. With a stunning 7-inch Liquid Retina display, HomeView brings entertainment, connection, and smart home management together in one place, from playing music and making FaceTime calls to home monitoring and hands-free automations with voice control — all designed with privacy and security at the core. 1 HomeView recognizes users by their faces, adapting so they can access their personal content in Messages, FaceTime, Calendar, Reminders, and Find My. HomeView features Siri AI, an entirely new version of Siri that’s profoundly more capable and conversational, with broad world knowledge that powers richer music discovery and onscreen awareness. When paired with an Apple Intelligence-enabled device, it can also draw on a user’s personal context, such as their Calendar, Messages, and relevant information across their apps, to provide more helpful, personalized responses. 2 

Designed to fit in any space, HomeView can be placed on a tabletop as the center of the home or wall-mounted to fit in spaces like the entryway or hallway. Pre-orders start today, with availability beginning November 13.

...

HomeView recognizes up to six people and delivers a personalized experience for each one. Each user gets their own personalized Home Screen with apps and widgets. Personal content stays private from others, while shared photo albums and music can be easily enjoyed by everyone in a household, including guests.

...

Pricing and Availability 

- Customers in Australia, Canada, India, New Zealand, the UK, and the U.S. can pre-order Apple HomeView in silver, starlight, rose pink, and space gray for $299 (U.S.), and Apple HomeView (Wall Mounted) in space gray and silver for $299 (U.S.), starting today from apple.com/store and in the Apple Store app. Customers in Singapore can pre-order starting Thursday, October 15, at 9 a.m. SGT. Both models will be available in these countries beginning Friday, November 13. Customers in South Africa will be able to pre-order Apple HomeView and Apple HomeView (Wall Mounted) through Apple Authorized Resellers, with availability beginning Friday, November 13. Apple HomeView is not available for sale in the European Union, as Siri AI is currently unavailable in iOS in the EU. Apple is working constructively with the EU in an attempt to find a path forward.

- HomeView (Wall Mounted) will be available with a choice of three purpose-built mounts from Schneider Home. Power Mount USB‑C Wall Connector, available starting at $59.95 (U.S.), and Power Mount AC Wired, available starting at $79.95 (U.S.), can be ordered starting today from apple.com/store and in the Apple Store app. Power Mount PoE Wired will be available starting in early 2027 for $129.95 (U.S.).

- Siri AI on HomeView is available in English in the U.S., Australia, Canada, India, New Zealand, Singapore, South Africa, and the UK.
